short: Conformer back-end on raw inputs (M06) and Transformer LM (M07) are standard: raw-input AVSR predates it, the Conformer gain is one confounded step, and RNN-T beats its LRS3 lip reading.
position: The paper [@ma2021conformers] changes the recognition back-end (M06: Conformer encoders trained jointly with ResNet-18 front-ends on raw pixels and waveforms) and the use-time language model (M07: a Transformer LM replacing a recurrent one). Both are standard by the verdict rules. Raw-input end-to-end audio-visual training predates it [@petridis2018e2e], and the Conformer, absent from every dated ledger study before it (Appendix), is credited from one LRS2 visual-only ablation step that also swaps the decoder (Table 2). Still, the recipe became a template: [later] Auto-AVSR keeps it and reaches 19.1% LRS3 visual-only WER from 3,448 h [@ma2023autoavsr], against 43.3% here, so later gains came from data, not architecture. The main overreach: a "large margin" LRS3 visual-only claim (§5) while Table 4 lists RNN-T at 33.6% [@makino2019rnnt]. No result carries seeds or intervals.
